title: Telemetry sprint soundboard + metric ownership map
content:
Purpose and context:

This is a lightweight planning doc for the next two telemetry sprints (cycles 2025-11/2025-12). Goal: produce a compact, prioritized metric catalog + trace enrichment plan and a minimal dashboard surface (Tier A/B) that supports fast incident triage and rollout gating for hosted/dedicated/private deployments. Emphasis: remove ambiguity in ownership and keep rollout small (3 microdashboards + 5 probes) so we can ship and iterate.

Quick notes / working assumptions (notes-to-self):
- Focus first on latency and cache-warmth signals for token-serving paths — those cause the biggest customer pain.
- Sampling budget is finite: target 2% overall trace-sampling for production with affinity for error/slow tail and tenant spikes.
- Dashboards should be cheap to query; use pre-aggregated SLI tables for minute-level panels.
- This doc is deliberately pragmatic: prototypes first, polish later.

Scope of work this sprint:
- Finalize metric definitions for 12 signals (see catalog).
- Implement trace enrichment hooks for session stitching and prompt provenance.
- Design 3 compact dashboards: Operator Overview (Tier A), Model Rollout Smoke (Tier A), Tenant Cost + Latency (Tier B).
- Define sampling policy and implement feature-flagged adaptive sampler.
- Assign ownership and hand-off plan for instrumentation.

Metric catalog (canonical defs - short):
1) request_total
   - description: total inference requests received by API fronting layer
   - unit: count/minute
   - agg: sum by model, region, customer_tier
   - owner: api-gateway

2) ttf_token_p50/p95/p99
   - description: time-to-first-token (ms) measured at model-runtime entry
   - unit: ms
   - agg: p50,p95,p99 by model_variant and hw_pool
   - owner: serving-runtime

3) kv_cache_hit_ratio
   - description: cached KV prefix hits / total cache lookups
   - unit: ratio (0..1)
   - agg: avg over 1m, labels: model, tenant_cohort
   - owner: serving-runtime-kv

4) eviction_rate_per_min
   - description: KV eviction events per minute per host
   - unit: evictions/min
   - owner: infra-cache

5) token_gen_cost_estimate
   - description: per-request cost estimate (GPU-ms normalized) — used for internal chargeback/backfill
   - unit: normalized-cost-units
   - owner: cost-observability

6) model_fallback_rate
   - description: fraction of requests that routed to fallback model variant due to capacity or errors
   - unit: ratio
   - owner: routing

7) cli_error_rate
   - description: 4xx/5xx errors surfaced to client (per 1k requests)
   - unit: rate
   - owner: api-gateway

8) session_rebuild_time_ms
   - description: time to reconstruct session context from storage (on cold-start)
   - unit: ms
   - owner: platform-session

9) prompt_hallucination_signal (heuristic)
   - description: lightweight quality signal from output-postprocess (confidence mismatch, rerank divergence)
   - unit: score bucketed (low/med/high)
   - owner: ml-quality

10) trace_span_density
   - description: spans emitted per request lifecycle (helps detect instrumentation regressions)
   - unit: count/request
   - owner: observability-instrumentation

11) probe_synthetic_latency
   - description: synthetic probe P50/P95 for each critical path (front->runtime->token)
   - unit: ms
   - owner: probes

12) query_cost_quota_remaining
   - description: remaining query budget for a tenant within billing window
   - unit: normalized-units
   - owner: billing-observability

Trace enrichment plan (high level):
- Add session_id and tenant_cohort tags to every span at the API layer.
- Propagate model_variant and hw_pool to runtime spans.
- Add prompt_snippet_hash (sha1 of first 200 chars) as non-PII field to span when feature-flag enabled.
- Use span attribute "prefetch_reason" for KV warm paths (e.g., PREFETCH_BY_CANARY, PREFETCH_BY_TIER).
- Ensure span size limits: no more than 6 custom tags for sampled traces; longer metadata goes to artifact store with linkage id.

Sampling strategy (practical):
- Baseline: 1% head-sampling across production.
- Adaptive overrides (priority order):
  1) All error-type spans (5xx, internal assertion) => keep
  2) Slow-tail sampling: requests with ttf_token_p99+ => keep
  3) Tenant spike detection: if requests/min for tenant > 3x baseline, sample at 10% for that tenant for the next 10 minutes
  4) Feature-flagged session-probes (canary tenants) => keep at 100%
- Implementation note: wire adaptive sampler to event-driven sampler service; keep configs in repo (infra/telemetry/sampler).

Dashboard design and prioritization:
Tier A - Operator Overview (single page microdash):
- Panels: global request rate, P95 TTF, KV cache warmth, error-rate by code, trace-sampling rate, quick links to trace search (prefilled for slow tail).
- Query budget: minute-level aggregated tables + sparkline widgets for last 60m.
- Audience: oncall + SRE.

Tier A - Model Rollout Smoke:
- Panels: rollout cohort p50/p95 latency, hallucination heuristic rate, fallback_rate, token_gen_cost_estimate delta vs baseline.
- Lightweight gating: if hallucination score increases > 2x and cost increases > 10% trigger manual hold.

Tier B - Tenant Cost & Latency:
- Panels: per-tenant cost burn, P95 latency, kv_hit_ratio, session_rebuild_time.
- Audience: solutions eng + CS for escalation.

Engineering handoff & ownership map (quick):
- api-gateway: request_total, cli_error_rate, session_id propagation, sampling header
- serving-runtime: ttf_token_p*, kv_cache_hit_ratio, eviction_rate
- infra-cache: eviction_rate_per_min
- routing: model_fallback_rate
- probes: probe_synthetic_latency + synthetic probe maintenance
- cost-observability: token_gen_cost_estimate + query_cost_quota_remaining
- observability-instrumentation: trace_span_density, instrumentation PRs and linting
- ml-quality: prompt_hallucination_signal + quality checks

Rollout checklist (MUST have for ship):
- [ ] Metric names and labels finalized + encoded in metric-lint rules
- [ ] Sampling policy config in feature-flagged rollout path
- [ ] Trace enrichment implemented behind feature flag (default off)
- [ ] 3 dashboards deployed to staging with low retention queries for smoke tests
- [ ] Oncall playbook stub created and linked in dashboard help
- [ ] Cost budget alert for token_gen_cost_estimate > threshold

Open questions / discussion items:
- How much PII risk do we accept for prompt_snippet_hash? Is hashing + truncation enough? (security review needed)
- Do we want tenant-level adaptive sampling to use absolute qps threshold or relative spike? (pros/cons below)
- Should we store detailed prompt provenance (user id, truncated prompt) in a separate artifact storage with RBAC rather than in spans?

Quick decisions to make by EOD 2025-11-14:
- Approve baseline sampler config (1% head, rules above)
- Approve three Tier A/B dashboards for initial roll (yes/no)
- Approve prompt_snippet_hash experiment scope (on/off)

Next steps / timeline:
- Sprint week 1 (Nov 11-15): finalize metrics and merge metric-lint rules; implement session_id propagation and basic spans.
- Sprint week 2 (Nov 18-22): implement sampler service hooks; deploy dashboards to staging; run simulated spike test.
- Sprint week 3 (Nov 25-29): small production rollout behind flag for 5 canary tenants; validate queries and costs; iterate UI.

Appendix: quick TODOs and scratches
- TODO: add SQL snippets for pre-aggregated SLI table (owner: cost-observability)
- TODO: schedule security review for prompt-hash approach (owner: Leah)
- Scratch: experiment idea — use a delta metric: rollout_p95_delta = rollout_p95 / baseline_p95 - 1 (fast signal for gating)

Contact / owner notes:
- Primary owner: Ava Chen (eng-observability) — ping in #obs-team and @Ravi for infra changes.
- If you take an action item above, add your name to the collaborator list and update status.

End of doc.
